narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Detailed Feature Demo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review and demonstration of the Travalo perfume atomizer. It identifies the common problem of perfume fading and the inconvenience of carrying large bottles, then presents the Travalo atomizer as the solution, highlighting its patented filling mechanism, interchangeable shells, and magnetic design. It concludes with a promotional discount code and call-to-action.
